title: Uniform models and Tor bounds on a locally closed stratum
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ in it, with ring of integers $\mathcal O_E$. An admissible coefficient $\Gamma$ here is a finite discrete commutative ring, $\mathcal O_E$, $E$, or $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ (including $\mathbf Z_\ell,\mathbf Q_\ell$ by $E=\mathbf Q_\ell$). Regard these as condensed rings [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring, sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed]. For a scheme $T$, set $\Gamma_T=p_T^*\Gamma$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients] on its small pro-étale site [sk-def-pe-site], and use ordinary uncompleted unbounded derived categories of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Scalar modules in a tensor denote constant sheaves, as in [det-def-sfb-constructible-local-model].

Fix a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$, $p\ne\ell$, a separated finite-type $k$-scheme $X$, and a locally closed immersion $a:S\hookrightarrow X$, with its induced $k$-structure [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting, def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-closed-immersion]. Then $S$ is Noetherian, quasi-compact and quasi-separated, has a finite affine open cover, and is separated of finite type over $k$; $a$ is separated of finite type [pqf-def-locnoeth, def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme, def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism, def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism].

Let $Q\in D(\Gamma_S)$ have a specified pro-étale covering on which it is the termwise scalar realization of bounded finite-projective $R=\Gamma(*)$-complexes [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex]. There is a finite affine pro-étale covering $\{V_i\to S\}_{i=1}^n$ refining that covering and retaining those scalar models $Q_i^\bullet$, and integers $r\le s$ such that $Q_i^q=0$ outside $[r,s]$. For all $q$,
$$H^q(Q)|_{V_i}\simeq\Gamma_{V_i}\otimes_RH^q(Q_i^\bullet),$$
with $H^q(Q_i^\bullet)$ finitely presented [def-sc-finitely-presented-module], and $H^q(Q)=0$ outside $[r,s]$. For every $\Gamma_S$-module sheaf $N$ in degree zero,
$$ (Q\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\Gamma_S}N)|_{V_i}\simeq(\Gamma_{V_i}\otimes_RQ_i^\bullet)\otimes_{\Gamma_{V_i}}N|_{V_i},$$
and its cohomology vanishes outside $[r,s]$. Thus $Q$ has bounded cohomology constructible on the single stratum $S$ and Tor amplitude in $[r,s]$, so $Q\in\Dctf(S,\Gamma)$ [det-def-sfb-constructible-tor-amplitude]. For empty $S$ the cover may be empty and one may take $r=s=0$.

proof.text: The field $k$ is Noetherian: its only ideals are $0$ and $k$. Thus $X$ is Noetherian by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian]. Factor the immersion as $S\xrightarrow{i}U\xrightarrow{j}X$ with $i$ closed and $j$ open. Apply [lem-sfb-noetherian-open-closed-finite-presentation] to this factorization: $a=ji$ is quasi-compact and locally of finite presentation, hence of finite type. By [lem-sfb-finite-type-composition-base-change], $S$ is of finite type over $k$, and hence Noetherian by the first cited lemma. The immersion $a$ is separated by [lem-weil-pbc-separated-cancellation](a); composition with the separated structural map of $X$ is separated by [lem-weil-pbc-proper-fp-permanence](e). Now [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-over-affine] gives qcqs for $S$, and [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-finite-affine-open-cover] gives a finite affine open cover. None of this requires $S$ to be reduced.

source.place: Tags 01T6 (lemma-finite-type-noetherian), 01T3 (lemma-composition-finite-type); the cited immersion and qcqs tools

proof.text: First suppose $S$ is nonempty. Apply [lem-sfb-finite-scalar-perfect-refinement] with $B=\Gamma_S$, $R=\Gamma(*)$, and the specified covering and specified complexes. It supplies a finite nonempty affine refinement retaining those very complexes, their restricted representing isomorphisms, and degreewise splittings into finite free coefficient sheaves. Enumerate its finite index set as $1,\ldots,n$ and call the retained scalar complexes $Q_i^\bullet$. Choose bounds $a_i\le b_i$ for these complexes and put $r=\min_i a_i$, $s=\max_i b_i$. Then $r\le a_i\le b_i\le s$, so $Q_i^q=0$ outside $[r,s]$. These integers are chosen before, and independently of, any tensor test module.

source.place: Tags 0989 (definition-fpqc-covering), 098A (lemma-recognize-proetale-covering), 098C (lemma-proetale); finite extrema of the retained bounds

proof.text: For each chart put $B_i=\Gamma_{V_i}$ and $E_i^\bullet=C_{V_i}(Q_i^\bullet)$. The chart models of the preceding step use $B|_{V_i}$; [lem-sfb-coefficient-sections-localization] identifies the pro-étale slice with $(V_i)_{\mathrm{proét}}$, and [sk-prop-sfb-cartesian-coefficients](1) identifies this restricted coefficient ring with $B_i$. Apply [lem-sfb-admissible-scalar-model-cohomology] on $V_i$. It gives finite presentation of every $H^q(Q_i^\bullet)$ and $H^q(E_i^\bullet)\simeq B_i\otimes_RH^q(Q_i^\bullet)$, for all the admissible coefficients, including integral coefficients. Restriction of module sheaves is exact by [lem-sfb-ringed-site-restriction-kflat]; hence [lem-sp-exact-functor-preserves-homology](c) applied to a representative of $Q$ identifies $H^q(Q)|_{V_i}$ with $H^q(Q|_{V_i})$. The representing isomorphism $Q|_{V_i}\simeq E_i^\bullet$ therefore gives the required cohomology isomorphism.

source.place: (2) Local models, cohomology calculation; exact scalar realization on each retained chart

proof.text: Each term $E_i^q$ is a retract of $B_i^{m_{iq}}$: apply scalar realization to the finite-projective inclusion and projection, obtaining $p\,u=1$. We check flatness explicitly, rather than assuming that scalar realization is exact for this purpose. Tensoring a short exact sequence with $B_i^{m_{iq}}$ gives its finite direct sum, which is exact. Tensoring with $E_i^q$ is a retract of this operation via $u\otimes1$ and $p\otimes1$. In the resulting sequence injectivity follows by applying $u$ and then using injectivity in the finite sum; a middle element in the kernel lifts in the finite sum and its lift projects by $p$ to a preimage; the same lift-and-project argument gives surjectivity. Thus tensoring with $E_i^q$ is exact, which is precisely flatness [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. Moreover $E_i^q=0$ outside $[r,s]$ by the retained model. Consequently [lem-pc-bounded-above-flat-kflat-site] makes $E_i^\bullet$ K-flat.

Fix any $\Gamma_S$-module sheaf $N$ in degree zero. Choose a flat-term K-flat resolution $T^\bullet$ of a representative of $Q$, using [lem-pc-kflat-resolution]. The one-sided comparison [lem-trf-site-one-sided-tensor-normalization] represents $Q\otimes^{\mathbf L}N$ by $T^\bullet\otimes N[0]$. Restrict to $V_i$. The restriction is K-flat by [lem-sfb-ringed-site-restriction-kflat] and has flat terms by [lem-weil-pbc-slice-restriction-flat]. The degreewise comparison [lem-sfb-localized-site-tensor-restriction] identifies the restricted tensor complex with $(T^\bullet|_{V_i})\otimes N|_{V_i}[0]$: in degree $q$ there is only the single tensor $T^q\otimes N$, so no infinite-sum interchange is needed. The one-sided comparison on the slice identifies its localization with $Q|_{V_i}\otimes^{\mathbf L}N|_{V_i}$. Replace $Q|_{V_i}$ by $E_i^\bullet$ and apply the same comparison using its K-flatness from Step 4. This proves exactly the displayed derived isomorphism with $E_i^\bullet\otimes_{B_i}N|_{V_i}[0]$. Its degree-$q$ term is $E_i^q\otimes_{B_i}N|_{V_i}$, zero for $q\notin[r,s]$, so its cohomology is zero in those degrees. No flatness or finite generation of $N$ is used.

source.place: Tags 06YS (lemma-K-flat-resolution), 06YU (definition-derived-tor and preceding one-sided construction), 0E8K (lemma-restriction-K-flat); sites-modules.tex Tag 0E8J (lemma-restriction-flat)

proof.text: For $q\notin[r,s]$, Step 3 and the scalar degree bounds show $H^q(Q)|_{V_i}=0$. Step 5, with exact restriction and its homology comparison, likewise shows $H^q(Q\otimes^{\mathbf L}N)|_{V_i}=0$ for every $N$. A module sheaf $F$ vanishing on every member of this covering is zero: for any test object $W$, pull the covering back to $W$ using [lem-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering-axioms](3) and the covering description [sk-def-pe-site]. The restriction of any section of $F(W)$ is zero on every $W\times_SV_i$, since those objects lie over $V_i$. The uniqueness part of the sheaf axiom forces the section to be zero. Apply this to the two cohomology sheaves just considered. This gives global cohomology vanishing outside $[r,s]$ and, since $N$ was arbitrary, global Tor amplitude in $[r,s]$.

source.place: Tag 098C (lemma-proetale), base change of coverings; separatedness axiom for sheaves

proof.text: For every $q$, the isomorphisms of Step 3 and finite presentation of $H^q(Q_i^\bullet)$ give a finite constant local model for $H^q(Q)$ on the very same cover, by [det-def-sfb-constructible-local-model]. Use the single stratum $S$ of itself: its underlying subset is open and closed and hence constructible, so this is an allowed finite locally closed stratification. By [det-def-sfb-constructible-tor-amplitude](1)--(4), Step 6 puts $Q$ in $\Dbc(S,\Gamma)$ with Tor amplitude in $[r,s]$, and therefore in $\Dctf(S,\Gamma)$. This uses ordinary uncompleted derived categories throughout, including for $\mathcal O_E$.

source.place: (2) Local models; membership in the ordinary constructible finite-Tor subcategory

proof.text: If $S$ is empty, every object of its small pro-étale site is empty and has the empty covering [sk-def-pe-site]. The sheaf axiom identifies sections of an abelian sheaf on that object with the terminal abelian group, hence with zero. Thus all module sheaves, all cohomology sheaves and all tensor tests are zero. Take the empty refinement and $r=s=0$. The cohomology model assertions on its members are vacuous; the required boundedness, constructibility and Tor assertions follow immediately from [det-def-sfb-constructible-tor-amplitude].

The integral case runs in ordinary uncompleted categories through the own-unit node lem-sfb-admissible-scalar-model-cohomology, which asserts that scalar realization is exact for O_E; that holds because C(π0,O_E) is torsion-free and hence flat. S1: the immersion is closed into open, so lem-sfb-noetherian-open-closed-finite-presentation gives quasi-compact and lfp; finite type and Noetherian follow over Spec k; separatedness comes from cancellation (a) and permanence (e); qcqs-over-affine and the finite affine cover follow. S3: slice identification plus α_f iso, then the scalar-model node on W=V_i, then exact restriction with exact-functor (c). S4: retract argument P∘I=1, correct flatness, then the bounded-above flat complex is K-flat. S5: K-flat flat-term resolution; the one-sided comparison works for arbitrary N[0]; restriction keeps K-flatness and flat terms; natural degreewise tensor restriction; E_i⊗N has terms only in [r,s]. S6: elementary vanishing on the cover through base change of covers and the separation axiom. S7: matches the local-model and Tor-amplitude definitions (1)-(4) literally, with S qcqs as a single constructible stratum. S8: empty case. Edge cases tested: empty S; Z/4 with [Z/4 -2-> Z/4]; integral torsion cohomology; Q̄_ℓ; disjoint local amplitudes; non-flat N.
